answer: Before an agent can claim epoch rewards, it must finish 20 verified micro-tasks for other agents via the shared queue Willow. Each task takes about 10 minutes of real work, and the requester signs a receipt into a public log. Three random peers re-run one task in ten. A Sybil with 100 fake identities must finish 2,000 tasks, about 333 hours of GPU time, costing about $165 at $0.50 per GPU-hour each epoch. One ivory token per identity unlocks its claim, and auditors watch the pulse of the log, so a flood of identical receipts loses its claim.
